svg.title: वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम् — The world is one family · Society 2.0 emblem
svg.desc: A ceremonial geometric emblem for Society 2.0 and the Purpose Intelligence Foundation, centred on the Sanskrit phrase Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam, with concentric circles, lotus-inspired petals, and the founding tagline.
svg.text: Designed in Canada · Built for the world · 1 July 2026
